entities.summary: Simisola Olayemi Onibuwe Johnson, was the first Nigeria woman to qualify as a Nigerian dentist and women's advocate who was the Minister for Social Development and Culture during the nation's second republic. Johnson and Grace Guobadia were both qualified as dentists in 1957, making them the first trained female dentists in Nigeria. She was also a chair of Allied Bank and the Lagos State branch of the National Council of Women Societies, and also a fellow of the National Postgraduate Medical College of Nigeria.
